title: Roll20 Player Attendance vs Prep Load
dataSources: Character sheets (`rpg:character`), VTT sessions (`rpg:session`), initiative rounds (`rpg:initiative`), encounters (`rpg:combat`), campaign ops (`rpg:ops`).
app: Tabletop campaign telemetry — D&D Beyond character exports, Roll20 session logs, initiative trackers, and campaign asset checklists — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rpg:session campaign=* prep_load_min=*
| stats avg(prep_load_min) as avg_prep_load_min, count as events by campaign
| sort - avg_prep_load_min
description: Shows average prep-load minutes by campaign for GM preparation.
value: Average prep-load minutes by campaign helps compare GM preparation across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `prep_load_min` on `rpg:session` events and normalize `campaign` so Splunk can summarize performance by campaign.
visualization: Bar chart of average prep-load minutes by campaign.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates the average prep-load minutes for each campaign so you can see what works best for GM preparation.
